xmldoc.short_description: Low-level HTTP request used by webread, webwrite and websave.

syntax.syntax_item: fullname = webREST(url, data, filename, params, options)
[fullname, contentType] = webREST(url, data, filename, params, options)

param_input_item.param_description: a string: address of the web service.
a string: body of the request, or [] (empty) for a request without body.
a string: file where the response body is written.
a scalar struct: name-value parameters of the request. Field values must be char, string, numeric or logical, and not sparse.
a weboptions object: request method, timeout, credentials, headers and certificate settings.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: absolute path of the file that holds the response.
a character vector: Content-Type header of the response, or an empty char when the server sends none.

description.p: webREST sends one HTTP request and saves the response body in filename. It is the internal building block of webread, webwrite and websave, which check the arguments, choose the file and decode the response. Scripts should use these functions instead.

When data is empty, the fields of params are added to url as an encoded query string. When data is not empty, it is sent as the body of the request and url is used as is; the special value '__WEBWRITE__' sends the fields of params as a form-encoded body instead.

The RequestMethod of options selects the HTTP method: 'get', 'post', 'put', 'delete' or 'patch'. With 'auto', a request with a body uses POST and a request without body uses GET. The Timeout of options limits the time to connect and the time the transfer may stall, not the length of the whole download. When the MediaType of options is 'auto', the request is sent with the Content-Type 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.
An HTTP error status deletes filename and raises the error Nelson:webREST:httpError. A network failure raises Nelson:webREST:curlError.

example_item.example_item_description: Request that needs a network connection.
